name: Google Workspace
description: Let agents read and work in Google Drive files, Sheets spreadsheets, Docs documents, Slides presentations, Gmail email, Calendar events, Forms, Tasks, Chat, Meet, Contacts and Apps Script through the Google APIs.

methods.label: Use your own Google OAuth app
methods.whenToUse: Use a Google OAuth client from your own Google Cloud project. Wardmote asks only for the scopes of the levels you pick.
methods.guidanceMd: Create a Google Cloud project, enable the Workspace APIs, create an OAuth client of type Web application with Wardmote's callback URI, then paste its Client ID and secret or drop its client_secret.json.
warnings: Deleting, sharing outside your domain and sending email ask for approval by default.
The "Delete and share" level for Drive uses the restricted drive scope.
